content:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary cohort for release_v2 shows sustained 503s and request rate stuck at ~0 for 4 of 6 hosts. Severity: P1. Pager sent to #eng-oncall.
anna_oncall: Got the pager, looking now. Which region is affected?
eng-release: EU-west canary group, started rollout 03:42 UTC. No config changes after deploy.
jules_sre: Loading metrics — LB shows traffic routed, but backend health checks failing with 503. Checking logs on canary hosts.
anna_oncall: pulling recent deploy logs
anna_oncall: logs show fast failure in infer-service startup: "failed to initialize kv-cache: mismatch quant kernel ABI" repeated on boot.
eng-release: Wait that message sounds like an incompatible kernel build landed in the canary pack. We deployed the v2 quantized runtime.
product-ops: Any customer impact? any external errors?
support-lead: A handful of EU customers reported elevated 5xx and slow responses via support channel, about 15% traffic hitting errors. Ticket #CS-1087 created.
jules_sre: Quick mitigation checklist: 1) divert traffic away from canary -> route all traffic to stable; 2) flip feature flag off; 3) if needed, rollback canary instances.
anna_oncall: Starting with routing: routing.apply --selector canary=release_v2 --weight 0
incident-bot: routing.apply success. Canary weight set to 0. Live traffic now 100% to stable.
anna_oncall: Flipping feature flag release_v2_canary -> off: `ff toggle release_v2_canary --off --user=anna_oncall`
eng-release: Flag toggled, confirm no more new sessions to canary.
support-lead: Support: customer errors dropping to ~2% from 15%, customers notified that we're investigating.
jules_sre: Rolling rollback plan: we should stop rollout build and remove faulty image from registry. Eng-release, can you confirm image id?
eng-release: image sha: sha256:7f3a2... faulty build is release_v2:2026-03-17-07. Pull blocked for new canaries. Starting image invalidation.
anna_oncall: Initiating emergency rollback for canary hosts: `deploy rollback --group canary --target stable-image`
incident-bot: rollback job queued (job id 67234). Progress tracked in /deploys/67234.
jules_sre: While rollback runs, checking why kernel ABI mismatch happened. Quick grep shows build agent used different glibc in toolchain for quant kernels. File `/builds/release_v2/artifacts/_metadata` shows toolchain=glibc-2.34 vs expected 2.31.
eng-release: That's the root cause. Patch build pipeline to pin toolchain version, will open PR.
anna_oncall: Rollback completed on 3 hosts, remaining 3 in progress. Error rates are back down to normal on EU.
support-lead: Notifying impacted customers: sending status update that traffic restored and rollback in progress.
product-ops: Any risk to Dedicated or Private deployments? This was a build issue in our hosted canary image only. No evidence of config drift elsewhere.
jules_sre: Agree. We'll block the bad image from promotion to Dedicated until pipeline fix.
eng-release: PR for build-toolchain pin opened: https://git.redwood/release/pulls/412 - includes CI gating.
anna_oncall: Handoff in 20 minutes to night oncall (jules takes on rotation). I'll summarize in incident channel and mark followups.
anna_oncall: Postmortem action items: 1) Add toolchain pin to release pipeline (eng-release) 2) Add image promotion hold when canary health fails (sre) 3) Improve canary startup health check to fail fast on ABI mismatches (runtime)
jules_sre: I'll take followups 1 and 2. Assigning tickets now.
incident-bot: incident updated: status=mitigated, impact=partial, customers_affected=small_set_eu, owner=anna_oncall.
anna_oncall: Closing pager. Leaving notes for oncall handoff.
anna_oncall: /me heading to handoff doc and will ping @jules_sre in 10m with final state."
